aggregation: max of native 18 m Horn slope over the native pixels sampled in the cell; NoData if any contributor is unknown or has NoData slope
layout: row-major from the north-west corner of each tile
subsamples_per_cell: 3x3 points per app cell, each mapped to its nearest native 18 m pixel
source: MRO CTX DEM 18 m, set 482 (g17_024822_1755_xi_04s076w_g17_024967_1755_xn_04s076w_tied-dem.tif), Day et al. 2023
